# fjordrun_ssh_server (Data Source)

The running on-demand SSH server of a service, if any: `running` is `false` when none is. Reading doesn't start one; see `fjordrun_ssh_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "service_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_ssh_server" "web" {
  service_id     = var.service_id
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Defaults to the project's default environment.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) A ready-made command to connect.
- `error` (String) Why it failed.
- `exec_command` (String) Example command to run one command.
- `expires_at` (String) The latest it stops.
- `forward_command` (String) Example command to forward a port.
- `forward_ports` (List of Number) Ports `-L` can forward to.
- `host` (String) Host to connect to.
- `host_key_fingerprint` (String) The server's host key.
- `id` (String) Session ID.
- `idle_timeout_minutes` (Number) It stops after this long without a connection.
- `message` (String) A hint while starting.
- `port` (Number) Port to connect to.
- `ready_at` (String) When it became ready.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether a server is running.
- `started_at` (String) Start time.
- `status` (String) `starting` or `ready`, or `stopped` if none is running.
- `username` (String) User to connect as.
